finding: The result page can show two sections with the same heading "เรื่องเวลาว่างและงานอดิเรก". contextGaps() still groups by raw q.c, so l and f are scored as separate topics (gaps can be ['l'], ['f'] or ['l','f']). chosenByCtx() merges f into l, but its skip test uses the raw q.c (skip.indexOf(q.c)), so f items are not skipped when 'l' is a gap topic (and l items are not skipped when 'f' is). Both functions write CTX_NAME[...] headings into the same <ul class=ctxs>, which gives the duplicate. The gap comparison for the merged topic is also split: l is compared against a rest that still contains f. Seen in 19 of 588 simulated full runs (about 5% of runs where l was chosen), at every length.
repro: Open r12/index.html#r1.c.Yjc.3lcfe.000120224442024041230211n44n301121303432333201114000144420121032334431001n122340344041232000042020440041001403.gp then click ทำต่อ. The result lists the headings เวลาว่างและงานอดิเรก, บ้านและห้องของตัวเอง, มือถือ แอป และ AI, เวลาว่างและงานอดิเรก. A second case, where gaps=['f'], is #r1.c.YzY.3lcfe.213324243n032404101100340403004024022232340414n343242302101112003n103412044021330114n4034100131113031041n4n02444.ry. Harness: scratchpad/aud12/engine.js, tape.js, ui.js.
suggested_fix: In contextGaps use var c = topicOf(set[it.i].c) as the grouping key. In chosenByCtx test skip.indexOf(topicOf(q.c)). Also consider using topicOf in agreements() for consistency.

finding: After 2 'na' answers on the merged topic, the prompt to skip the whole topic is offered only if an unanswered item with x.c === 'l' remains. If only f items remain, the prompt is suppressed, even though dropTopic('l') would replace them. Seen in 3–4 of 588 simulated runs.
repro: node scratchpad/aud12/engine.js r12/index.app.js 40 reports 'drop prompt suppressed: only follower items remain' (e.g. seed f12, chips l+e, 64).
suggested_fix: In applyAnswer's return condition use topicMembers(topic).indexOf(x.c) >= 0 instead of x.c === topic.

finding: ctxList() returns ['l','f'] when only the เวลาว่างและงานอดิเรก chip is checked. Because plan() checks ctxList.length >= minChosen, one chip unlocks 84 and 92 and the guard text is cleared. Any other single chip (c, e, w, ...) keeps 84/92 locked with the message 'เลือกอย่างน้อย 2 เรื่องเพื่อปลดล็อก 84 และ 92 ข้อ', which is now inaccurate for l. surCount(list.length) also counts f, so an l-only user gets one fewer surprise topic than any other single chip (64: 2 instead of 3; 56: 1 instead of 2). The pools are big enough, since every length built, so this is a semantics and copy issue rather than a crash.
repro: Setup: click ล้างที่เลือก, check only เวลาว่างและงานอดิเรก. Lengths read '56 64* 84 92' and the guard is empty. Check only บ้านและห้องของตัวเอง and you get '84x 92x' plus the guard text.
suggested_fix: Decide the intent. If 'topics' means chips, count distinct topicOf() values in plan()/surCount() (e.g. list.filter(c => !CTX_FOLLOW[c]).length). If the merged pool is meant to count as two, reword the guard, e.g. 'เลือกอีก 1 เรื่อง (หรือเลือกเวลาว่างและงานอดิเรก) เพื่อปลดล็อก 84 และ 92 ข้อ'.

finding: pickSurprise never offers f, which is correct, and never duplicates a chosen topic (0 cases). But when l is drawn as a surprise topic, its follower f is not added to sur, so a surprise 'เวลาว่างและงานอดิเรก' uses only the l pool. This is inconsistent with 'one chip, both pools'.
repro: Choose only งาน, seed s.t. pickSurprise returns 'l' (e.g. inspect usedSur). No f items appear in phase 1.
suggested_fix: Optional. After pickSurprise, expand followers: sur = sur.concat(Object.keys(CTX_FOLLOW).filter(k => sur.includes(CTX_FOLLOW[k]) && !chosen.includes(k))). Keep surCount based on topics, not raw codes.

finding: Saved rev11 runs (ft11_run_*, v:11) fail validRun() and are deleted by prune() without any notice. A user with a half-done or finished rev11 run lands on setup with no explanation. Nothing breaks: no JS errors, and new v:12 runs are saved correctly. The only old-version notice is for ft10_progress. Resume links from rev11 correctly show RESUME_ERR.old, and rev11 s1. share links still render because decodeShare ignores the version.
repro: Seed localStorage ft11_run_old1 = {v:11, seed:'มะลิ12', chosen:['w','r','l'], L:64, tape:['4','3','2','1'], at:now} and load the page. You get setup with no warning. After Start, only the ft11_run_<new>:12 key remains.
suggested_fix: On boot, if loadLocal() returns null and any ft11_run_* has v !== BANKV, call renderSetup(RESUME_ERR.old) once (or use similar wording), then let prune delete the record.

finding: CH_PREC = '90–95' is shown as 'ราว 90–95%', but the verification footnote says the three simulations gave 95%, 96% and 91%. The calibration files r12/cal/cA/cB/cC.txt give 94.6%, 95.5% and 90.5%. The rounded footnote implies 91–96, and the CH_PREC range uses truncation, so the two disagree on the same page.
repro: In a passing result, compare the 'ผ่านการเช็กซ้ำ' line (90–95) with the footnote (95%, 96%, 91%).
suggested_fix: Use one rounding. Either CH_PREC '91–96' with footnote 95/96/91, or CH_PREC '90–95' with footnote 95/95/90 ('ราว'). Keep the CHANGELOG (94.6/95.5/90.5) as the source.
